result.title: Real-Time Neurological Insights: Scaling NeuroDX AI with NVIDIA Inception
result.description: Traditional health monitoring often relies on intermittent measurements, making early detection of neurological and physiological changes difficult. NeuroDX AI addresses this challenge by using AI to decode complex multimodal bio signals. Powered by NVIDIA H200 GPUs, TensorRT™, and NVIDIA Triton™ Inference Server, NeuroDX AI accelerates model training and optimizes inference for ultra-low latency and high throughput. Discover how NVIDIA's Inception program enabled NeuroDX AI with specialized training, early technology access, venture capital connections, and global showcase opportunities to turn complex bio signal data into actionable health intelligence.

result.title: Securely Deploy Autonomous Agents in Your AI Factory | AI Factory Insider Ep. 3
result.description:

40:14 — Wrap-up

result.title: Physical AI is here—the next wave of AI and the foundation of the next industrial revolution.
result.description:
Physical AI is here—the next wave of AI and the foundation of the next industrial revolution.

NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang outlines the full stack making it possible: Cosmos and Omniverse to develop physical AI in virtual worlds, Isaac and Newton where robots learn skills in physics-simulated gyms, and Jetson robotics computers where their intelligence runs.

Together with Japan’s robotics and manufacturing leaders, NVIDIA is creating a new era of industrial automation.

result.title: How BharatGen is building India AI with NVIDIA Nemotron
result.description:
BharatGen, a leading model builder under the IndiaAI Mission, is collaborating with NVIDIA to build India’s foundational AI infrastructure using a fully open model approach. By combining Indian datasets with the NVIDIA accelerated computing platform and Nemotron libraries, BharatGen is training multimodal models with up to one trillion parameters, tailored to India’s languages,  cultural nuances and local industries.

By releasing model weights, datasets, and training recipes on Hugging Face, BharatGen aims to enable developers, startups, and enterprises across India to fully customize and deploy open, state-of-the-art AI solutions.

Get started with BharatGen’s models - https://bharatgen.com/
Get started with NVIDIA Nemotron - https://developer.nvidia.com/topics/ai/nemotron
